Sparse Sketches for Streaming Graph Clustering. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of clustering graphs that arrive as a stream of edges. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the road network benchmarks and achieves state of the art performance on the social graph collections. A full treatment of adversarial edge orderings is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Learned Index Structures for Time Series. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of learned indexes over sensor time series. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the industrial telemetry archive and achieves state of the art performance on two public weather datasets. A full treatment of concept drift in the indexed data is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Contrastive Pretraining for Protein Contact Maps. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of contrastive pretraining for predicting protein contacts. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the held-out protein families and achieves state of the art performance on the membrane protein subset. A full treatment of multiple sequence alignment quality is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Robust Keypoint Matching under Motion Blur. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of keypoint matching in blurred video. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the handheld capture benchmark and achieves state of the art performance on the drone footage set. A full treatment of rolling shutter distortion is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Federated Topic Models for Clinical Notes. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of topic models trained across hospitals without pooling notes. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the discharge summary corpus and achieves state of the art performance on the radiology report corpus. A full treatment of differential privacy accounting is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Efficient Beam Search for Speech Recognition. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of pruning strategies for speech recognition beam search. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the read speech benchmark and achieves state of the art performance on the conversational telephone set. A full treatment of language model fusion is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Causal Discovery from Irregular Event Logs. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of causal discovery from irregularly sampled event logs. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the manufacturing logs and achieves state of the art performance on the simulated supply chain. A full treatment of latent confounders is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Graph Neural Networks for Power Grid Faults. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of locating faults in power grids with graph neural networks. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the regional transmission model and achieves state of the art performance on the distribution feeder set. A full treatment of cascading failures is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Low-Rank Adapters for Legal Text Classification. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of low-rank adapters for classifying legal judgments. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the appellate court corpus and achieves state of the art performance on the contract clause benchmark. A full treatment of cross-jurisdiction transfer is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Self-Supervised Depth from Endoscopic Video. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of self-supervised depth estimation in endoscopy. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the colonoscopy recordings and achieves state of the art performance on the synthetic phantom set. A full treatment of specular highlights on tissue is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Active Learning for Coral Reef Imagery. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of active learning for labelling coral reef photographs. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the reef survey archive and achieves state of the art performance on the citizen science uploads. A full treatment of seasonal changes in water colour is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

sources.title: Compressing Recommendation Embeddings with Hashing. Invented for this set: stock phrasing in ten sources and more.
sources.text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study of hashing to compress recommendation embeddings. Experimental results show that the proposed method sets a new state of the art on the retail click logs and achieves state of the art performance on the music listening sessions. A full treatment of cold start for new items is beyond the scope of this paper. The rest of this paper is organized as follows.

documents.title: Chapter 1 (draft)
documents.text: Retrieval systems have always encoded a view of what their users need. Early search tools ranked documents by the words they shared with a query, and that habit shaped how a generation of researchers wrote their abstracts. Neural models changed the unit of comparison from the word to the passage. What a model counts as similar is therefore a design decision with consequences for which papers get read. This chapter traces that decision from inverted indexes to dense retrieval.

documents.title: Workshop abstract
documents.text: We study how researchers move between their reading notes and their drafts. Across twelve interviews, participants described losing track of which sentences they had copied and which they had written themselves. Most kept quotations in a separate file and rarely went back to it while drafting. We argue that a writing tool should keep the source of every copied sentence within reach rather than asking the writer to remember it.
